# Plan file format

Create a plan file only when the work benefits from an explicit plan. Filename: `YYYY-MM-DD HHMM Plan - Subject.md`

Keep the status line current.

---

```md
status: active | complete | abandoned

# Plan — Subject
_Created: YYYY-MM-DD HHMM_

## Goal

## Steps
1.
2.
3.

## Notes
```
